apps.localizedDescription: Madeira Nightly runs Windows PC games on compatible iPhones using FEX-Emu, Wine, and Metal. This unofficial listing follows camhoc/Madeira releases. Requires JIT; follow the project instructions for device compatibility and setup.

**Madeira Nightly 0.2.180**
Everything since 0.2.101 (the version number now matches the build number). This is a test build and has not been tested on a device yet: please send a log with Get Help for anything that breaks.

**App**
• **Storage screen:** see what uses space, remove several games at once, and choose whether their files go too
• **Store pages:** Install and Update work from the sheet, and it no longer reopens after you close it
• **Remove from Library:** the confirmation now appears on the page you are on
• **Steam:** pick the download server in Settings
• **About:** shows the version and whether a newer build exists
• Clearer default resolution label; overlays follow the screen's orientation

**Controls**
• Attempted fix for controllers that did nothing in Madeira but worked in other apps
• Option to swap A/B and X/Y on any controller
• The mouse stick can be turned off from the config

**Game fixes (not yet tested on a device)**
• **Baldur's Gate 3:** Madeira Dock starts the game without Larian's launcher
• **Grounded:** recommended settings start the game program directly
• **Stray and other Unreal games:** fix for the "Microsoft Visual C++ Runtime" box
• **Resident Evil Requiem:** new memory settings (turn off with `pool-low = 0`)
• **Subnautica 2:** settings against an early crash
• **Fallout 4:** fix for a crash shortly after Play
• **RimWorld:** attempt at the blank menu text
• **Garry's Mod:** opt-in fix for its folder check (`env.MADEIRA_PLAIN_DIR_LINKS = 1`)
• **Madeira Dock:** retries instead of failing with error 41; games whose program sits in a subfolder find their DLLs
• **Elden Ring:** can start without Easy Anti-Cheat (offline only)
• **GTA IV:** opt-in wait for its Rockstar launcher pipe
• Extra logging for Halo: MCC, R.E.P.O. and some crashes

**Optional font:** the app includes Liberation Sans (SIL Open Font License), renamed to "Arial", for games that show no text without it. It is off; turn it on with `env.MADEIRA_ARIAL_FONT = 1`.

Thanks to BOR1NG (Avery Felts), MetalSharp-Wine (LGPL-2.1, FEX parts MIT), Mesa/KosmicKrisp (MIT) and the Liberation Fonts project. Full source for this build is attached.

Everything since 0.2.100. This is a test build and has not been tested on a device yet: please send a log with Get Help for anything that breaks.

**Controls**

• **Baldur's Gate 3** launcher: room for the fourth Chromium memory pool

**Madeira Nightly 0.2.100**
Everything since 0.2.95. This is a test build: please send a log with Get Help for anything that breaks.

**New**
• **New look:** more screens use Apple's standard style (start screen, store pages, the "Did it work?" card, Get Help, first-time setup)
• **Controllers on iPad:** no more second (blue) highlight on menus
• **DX12 games:** newer KosmicKrisp (Mesa 26.3.1), and compiled shaders are saved, so later launches start faster
• **Steam:** the Launch arguments field now works when "The game" is picked
• **Touch camera:** with Pointer mode set to Relative, finger camera follows your sensitivity setting
• **Mouse lock (iPad):** keeps asking again if iPadOS says no at first
• **Tap to click:** better timing for taps and tap-and-hold
• **Game Dock:** finds PhysX and other installers in every Steam library, including external drives

**Game fixes**
• **Raft** reaches the main menu
• **Left 4 Dead 2** start fix
• **Baldur's Gate 3** launcher: memory and .NET fixes (still closes after about 11 s; more logs added)
• **Batman: Arkham** games reach the title screen with PhysX
• **Black Ops 3, Overwatch 2:** more logging to find their crashes

**Known issues**
• Baldur's Gate 3 and Black Ops 3 still close early
• A few games need a short hold instead of a quick tap to click

Thanks to BOR1NG (Avery Felts), MetalSharp-Wine (LGPL-2.1, FEX parts MIT) and Mesa/KosmicKrisp (MIT). Full source for this build is attached.

**Madeira Nightly 0.2.95 (original bundle ID, build 173)**

A nightly build for testers. It uses the original bundle ID `com.willfaust.madeora`. The complete source of this exact build is attached (`Madeira Nightly 0.2.95 og source.zip`): the Madeira tree as it was built, with the wine, FEX, DXMT and Dock folders and Madeira's own FEX and Dock patches already applied.

This build contains code ported from MetalSharp (AGPL-3.0), written by BOR1NG (Avery Felts, https://github.com/aaf2tbz): the Overwatch 2 fixes, section views, debug registers, XSAVE state revert and the opt-in Intel flag behaviour. It also contains code from MetalSharp-Wine (LGPL-2.1) and MetalSharp's FEX patches (MIT), and from Mullion (LGPL-2.1-or-later, https://github.com/dttdrv/mullion). Thank you. Details are in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md and SOURCE-INFO.txt. Madeira's own code stays GPL-3.0-or-later.

Not included in the source: private keys and tokens, and the build machine's scripts.

**Madeira Nightly 0.2.75**
Everything big since 0.2.32

**Where we were at 0.2.32**
- Built on the older Wine (11.4) and older FEX and DXMT
- Batch uninstall, Move Games, Reset All / Verify All, session menu tabs, mouse lock, auto controller setup, BepInEx mods and Get Game Parts had just landed
- Overwatch 2 didn't get in game
- LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga drew a black world

**Tested and working on our phones**
- **Wine 11.22:** a big under-the-hood update, plus newer FEX and DXMT
- **DirectX 12 games** start and show a picture again
- **Resident Evil Village:** plays full screen, and the intro and prologue videos play (use Wi-Fi, see below)
- **Slay the Spire 2:** black screen fixed
- **Deep Rock Galactic (DX11):** runs great, over 100 FPS in places
- **LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga:** the world draws again
- **Battle.net** launcher opens again
- **Steam** no longer hangs for minutes when it can't connect
- **DirectX badge** shows which DirectX the game really used
- **Console look:** Settings → Appearance → Console look
- **Fewer crashes** in games that start lots of threads

**New, not tested yet (tell us how it goes)**
- **Fallout: New Vegas:** launcher window shows again
- **Satisfactory:** crash at start and the Visual C++ (x64) box fixed
- **Slay the Spire 2:** smoother, built-in setting
- **Vintage Story:** missing graphics fixed
- **Controllers:** more fixes in games
- **Screen and controller hints:** the store title shows once, steadier focus outlines, the hint bar wraps to two rows, and lists and Library buttons clear the hint bar
- **Test Run mode:** off by default
- **OpenAL game sound:** for games that need OpenAL but don't bring their own (BIT.TRIP BEAT and similar)
- **Share Logs** now includes the game's own log files
- **Crash logs** now show the last moments before a crash or freeze
- **Back button** easier to tap in landscape

**Known issues**
- **Deep Rock Galactic:** DX11 works great, but DX12 doesn't start yet. Keep it on DX11.
- **Overwatch 2** and **Black Ops III** don't get in game yet
- **Project Zomboid** can run out of memory when a world loads
- **On cellular**, Steam can go offline after Enable JIT, so some games close. Use Wi-Fi.

Send a log with Get Help for anything that breaks 🙏

Made by camhawk

**Game fixes**
• **BeamNG.drive** (ARM64): shaders work

**App fixes**
